The President’s Leadership Academy (PLA) is led by President Vitelli. PLA is intended to serve high potential and emerging leaders interested in personal and professional growth as well as leadership, administration, and management opportunities. The goal is to select a class of individuals who provide diversity of thought and lived experiences as well as differing professional backgrounds/experiences.
